deadline_delivered.english: The end time %s was reached: %d of the target %d leads were delivered, and the task was stopped.
deadline_delivered.chinese: 已到结束时间 %s：交付 %d 条（目标 %d 条），任务已停止。
deadline_delivered.traditional chinese: 已到結束時間 %s：交付 %d 條（目標 %d 條），任務已停止。

mail_delivered.chinese: 已交付线索：%d 条（目标 %d 条）
mail_delivered.traditional chinese: 已交付線索：%d 條（目標 %d 條）

mail_at_deadline.english: Delivered at the schedule's end time, %s UTC: %d of the target %d.
mail_at_deadline.chinese: 已按定时结束时间 %s（UTC）交付：%d 条，目标 %d 条。
mail_at_deadline.traditional chinese: 已按定時結束時間 %s（UTC）交付：%d 條，目標 %d 條。

mail_attached.english: The full list with evidence is attached as CSV.
mail_attached.chinese: 完整名单和证据见附件 CSV。
mail_attached.traditional chinese: 完整名單和證據見附件 CSV。

mail_test_body.english: This is a test message. Lead lists will be delivered to this address when a round finishes.
mail_test_body.chinese: 这是一封测试邮件。每轮任务结束时，线索名单会发到这个地址。
mail_test_body.traditional chinese: 這是一封測試郵件。每輪任務結束時，線索名單會發到這個地址。
